cc:Work.dc:description: Normal loads in kN, not contact-patch areas. All curve stages hold downforce at 4905 N: static, braking at 0.6g, then braking while cornering at 1g. Outer traces are solid; inner traces dashed. The top view shows the final state. These are prescribed accelerations, not measured Tesla performance.
